steps: Sign up free at kashkick.com and confirm your email.
Browse the game offers and read the milestones and required timeframe on each offer before starting.
Play each game until you hit the required milestone (official: game offers pay significantly more, some up to $800 at milestones).
Wait out any verification-pending period on game/deal rewards — they clear automatically.
Complete first-cashout identity verification if prompted (photo ID and selfie may be required).
Once your balance reaches $10, cash out via PayPal, Venmo, a gift card, or donate to charity — payouts process within 1–3 business days with no cashout fee.
